evidence: Actual selected native loader/register/tool/memory dispatch through immutable closure and root observed issuer; mutated closure/resolver/parent, caller channel/role, wrong PID/profile/generation, sibling artifact, dynamic import/path escape, grant replay and private/public leak negatives; source inventory fixtures alone do not qualify native issuer.
state: specification; installed closure and rooted source issuer not yet qualified
root_catalog: native_packages strict root-owned immutable selected profile/generation records
mount: Root resolves opaque package root/mount from custody profile enrollment; immutable read-only closure visible only to selected service UID/private mount namespace. Caller journal root is separate. Root verifies all closure files/digests/path containment/no symlink escape/executable roles; no caller path/mount/loader/module or mutable profile plugin injection. Native package absence leaves native adapter unavailable.

binder.caller: Only authenticated enrolled running native producer through profile-specific authority socket; root joins SO_PEERCRED UID/PID starttime/PIDFD/exe/cgroup/current profile generation, never caller profile/role claims
binder.semantics: Opaque binding resolves fixed in-process immutable loader/resolver only; not bearer authority. Root registry fixes issuer channels and action enrollment. No root access to arbitrary plugin imports from caller paths.

plugin_effects.operation: Exact selected plugin.<adapter-id>.<verb> from RB08; method name invoke is local facade, never unconstrained root generic proxy
plugin_effects.semantics: Facade derives immutable selected effect enrollment from bound package resolver; root verifies peer/package/generation/action/schema plus canonical complete argument digest and trusted source closure, issues fresh exact effect authorization and calls fixed backend handler. No source sensitivity/credential/role/capability/target supplied by worker.
plugin_effects.result: Typed RB08 result schema or owned immutable output artifact receipt; source receipt for effect result created only by root observing bounded actual backend result.

source_issuer.capture_api: capture_source(payload:bytes,parent_receipt_handles=()) -> opaque peer-bound provenance handle; channel/role selected by root listener and live registry, never caller source_kind/sensitivity
source_issuer.trust: Native-input requires root-observed selected authenticated user ingress/channel and exact event bytes; arbitrary worker submitted bytes remain UNKNOWN/private rather than proof of user/public origin. Tool/memory/effect results require root-observed registered invocation/result binding, not a worker claim; child joins exact parent/delegation/child peer admission, schedule root timer issuer. Missing actual observer preserves unavailable qualified capability, not permanently omitted original scope.
source_issuer.context: All actual parent receipt closure inherited; receipt ancestry is provenance not repeat-effect authorization. Public clearance separate trusted exact-payload user review, no labels.

artifacts.read: Opaque owned artifact ID with separate typed bounded root reads; no filesystem path/URL in response and no cross-profile receipt transfer

resolver_reader.adapters: Finite list of records with adapter_id,manifest_sha256,adapter_sha256,action_id,argument_schema_id,result_schema_id,effect_enrollment_id,operation,capability,target_id,recipient,generation matching package catalog; extra fields forbidden
resolver_reader.semantics: Root returns canonical bounded immutable resolver document from selected closure after same actual peer/package/generation validation; maximum2MiB and <=692 selected declarations. No request path, FD, module import or caller mount choice. Root selected loader reads only enrolled read-only namespace closure internally. Facade resolver is presentation/routing only: root re-resolves current effect enrollment and all identity/authority/schema/source conditions EVERY effect, never trusts returned record as permission.

operation_recipes.key: fixed root-reviewed operation_id; unique exact per selected profile/generation
operation_recipes.constraints: Root resolves executable/cwd/child artifacts from protected catalog and opaque roots, verifies actual pins. argv_recipe finite literals and typed parameter placeholders only; no caller shell/argv/path/env/URL/executable/substitution. cwd_subpath protected enrollment literal validated containment/no symlinks. environment root finite sanitized literals/ref bindings, never caller env or secret argv. stdin_mode closed|bounded-typed-bytes per schema, max lifetime<=600s unless separately reviewed existing operation cap. Parameters exact schema extra fields forbidden, argument output bounds required. Operation recipe selection not independent authorization: fixed process.start effect target and exact operation_id/parameters digest in grant. Missing recipe/pin/build dependencies unavailable.

protected_file_schema.owner_mode: root-owned regular file0600, no symlink; parent root-owned no worker writes
protected_file_schema.native_packages: list exact package_record_fields above; adapter_records is list exact adapter_record_fields; unknown/duplicate keys or IDs denied. All package/adapter generations opaque strings. Resolve artifact IDs/root mount IDs only against existing protected enrollment catalogs.
protected_file_schema.source_action_ids: finite root-selected actions per channel; native-input=authenticated-input; tool-result=registered-tool-result; memory-result=registered-memory-result; effect-result=registered-effect-result; delegated-child=registered-child-result; schedule-event=root-timer-event. These are observer contract IDs, not caller selectable source kinds.
protected_file_schema.joins: source observer_enrollment_id joins actual root registered ingress/backend result/job observer; channel/actions must match captured actual event/action. Package profile/generation joins root process_profiles/principals; adapter effect_enrollment_id joins selected_plugin_effects finite operation/schema/recipient. Missing actual observer/mount/closure identity remains unavailable; file presence not execution proof.
